Ritual of Summoning is a warlock ritual used to summon party or raid members by creating a Summoning Portal. The spell requires two additional party or raid members to complete.

Ritual of Doom is a Warlock spell that when cast, sacrifices a participating party member's life for the benefit of summoning a Doomguard. It requires the caster and four other party members to participate in the summoning. This summons a hostile Doomguard that soon becomes automatically subjugated as an additional guardian pet for the Warlock. The Doomguard lasts up to 15 minutes, but has a small chance to break free from the subjugation at any time and attack your group.

River Golem was hiding north of River Arevass when Illidan Stormrage killed him. Illidan and Malfurion were together trying to save Tyrande Whisperwind from attacks by the Scourge by attacking from opposite sides.

Riverbeast refers to two different types of large, -like animals. The first type is native to and is distinguished by their rocky plates and long, club-like tails.
